v2_egyptian_taxonomy.model: yolov8n fine-tuned v3 (30 epochs, lr0=0.003, cos decay), imgsz 320
v2_egyptian_taxonomy.dataset: 275 hand-reviewed Egyptian-market images, 23 classes, 85/15 split (239 train / 36 val), full-image boxes; provenance in data/provenance2.csv
honest_caveats: 14 of 23 classes now reach AP50 0.995 (incl. copper_red, aluminum_shavings, sand, steel_sheet, brick_white after the top-up harvest).
Remaining weak classes (brass, steel_pipes, steel_scrap, copper_scrap partial) have 5-6 training images and one val image each; scores on them swing heavily between retrains.
wood_zan vs wood_swed confusion remains the dominant error among strong classes.
Overall improved over v2: mAP50 0.661 -> 0.696, recall 0.490 -> 0.616 at same top-1 58%.
